name: 工业深底安全黄钢丝钳款
description: 深灰工业风钢丝钳套图：舞台首屏、痛点警示、结构标注、规格尺寸、锻造微距、多用宫格收口

styleLock.backgroundSystem: dark graphite studio walls alternating with light grey info panels, yellow-black hazard stripe divider motif
styleLock.lightingSystem: directional soft studio key from upper left with rim fill, controlled steel highlights, soft contact shadows
styleLock.surfaceSystem: dark stepped display blocks and matte stone surfaces
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, bold condensed headlines with small safety-yellow capsule labels
styleLock.iconSystem: thin white line icons with yellow accent dots
styleLock.presentationRules: stable slightly-open pliers silhouette, consistent 3/4 and side angles, yellow-black dipped handles and steel jaws rendered accurately, every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent industrial premium tool ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of dark graphite background #2E3238, light grey panel #F4F5F7, deep charcoal text #2D2D2D, and safety yellow accent #FFD100; neutral temperature; modern geometric sans-serif headlines with small safety-yellow capsule labels; dark studio walls alternating with light grey info panels with a yellow-black hazard stripe divider motif; directional soft studio key light from upper left with rim fill and soft contact shadows; thin white line icons with yellow accents; product shown with accurate steel jaws and yellow-black dipped handles at stable scale; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 用暗色舞台与醒目标题承接点击，1 秒建立工业质感与核心卖点
shots.camera: slight 3/4 front angle, eye-level, full product visible standing slightly open
shots.lighting: directional soft studio key from upper left, subtle rim from right, soft contact shadow under the tool
shots.background: dark graphite seamless wall with vertical fluted panels #3A3F46, stepped display blocks #23262B
shots.textZone: top-left headline block with a safety-yellow capsule label below it; left column with three icon labels
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce hero opening screen of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. {product} stands slightly open at a slight 3/4 front angle, eye-level, resting on dark stepped display blocks. Directional soft key light from upper left, subtle rim from right, soft contact shadow grounding the tool. Dark graphite seamless wall #3A3F46 with vertical fluted panel texture, podium blocks #23262B. Top-left headline block: 「{selling_point_1}」 in silver-grey #E8EAED with a small safety-yellow #FFD100 capsule label 「{callout_1}」 below it; along the left edge a column of three thin white line icons labeled 「{selling_point_2}」 「{selling_point_3}」 「{selling_point_4}」 in #FFFFFF. The tool fills 50-60% of the frame, with the upper-left dark field holding the headline block so the whole frame reads as one complete balanced composition. 2K commercial e-commerce quality. Negative: no brand logo, no watermark, no garbled text, no hands, no clutter, no gradient banding, no cut-off edges, no floating product.

shots.intent: 以图标矩阵快速铺陈品质与售后承诺，消除基础疑虑
shots.camera: flat front-facing layout, no camera perspective, graphic grid
shots.lighting: even soft studio light, no harsh shadows, flat graphic rendering
shots.textZone: centered headline at top; six labels under the 3x2 icon grid
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce trust icon-wall infographic summarizing the quality promises behind {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Flat top-down graphic layout, the product itself is not rendered. Bold centered headline 「{callout_2}」 at the top in #FFFFFF 32pt. Below, six thin white line icons arranged in a 3x2 grid on lighter graphite #4A5058, each with a short label 「{selling_point_2}」 「{selling_point_3}」 「{selling_point_4}」 「{selling_point_5}」 「{callout_4}」 「{callout_5}」 in #FFFFFF at 14pt, yellow accent dots on the icons. Even flat lighting. The icon grid fills about 65% of the panel with even generous margins so it reads as one complete balanced layout. Negative: no product rendered in this frame, no fake certification logos, no brand marks, no watermark, no dense body text, no garbled characters, no photographic elements.

shots.intent: 放大劣质钳子带来的具体困扰，制造替换动机
shots.lighting: even flat light, slightly heavier tone on the warning label bars
shots.props: three rounded vertical cards holding muted grey-toned scene vignettes
shots.textZone: top center headline with yellow divider; one label bar under each card
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point infographic for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Flat layout on near-white #F7F8FA: bold headline 「{callout_2}」 top center in #2D2D2D 32pt with a small safety-yellow #FFD100 divider below; three rounded vertical cards in a row, each holding a muted desaturated grey-toned vignette of a common frustration — an old pliers slipping on a wire, a worn dull cutting edge, a stiff corroded joint — rendered hazy and low-contrast against frame panels #DCDFE4, the center card deeper grey #9AA0A8. Each card is finished with a label bar reading 「{callout_3}」 in #FFFFFF on #2D2D2D, the center label bar on safety yellow #FFD100 with #2D2D2D text. Even flat lighting. The three cards fill 65-75% of the frame overall, with even margins completing one balanced layout. Negative: no gore or injury, no real defects on {product} itself, no invented statistics, no brand logos, no watermark, no dense text, no garbled characters, no hands.

provenance.notes: 10 张详情页切片提炼，合并重复角色为 9 镜；已剥离千图出品/QIANTU 水印、二维码会员贴片、英文乱码副标及『源于德国技术』等专有话术，钢材硬度等参数改为文案槽位由使用方填写；品类按主图判定为 家装灯具/五金工具，与源夹名『五金』不一致，已按 taxonomy 实际条目修正。
